newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coeur d'Alene EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coeur d'Alene EPS view up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it is raising its estimates for Coeur d'Alene Mines Corp to a loss of $0.28 a share from a loss of $0.37 for fiscal 1996 and its full year 1997 estimate to a profit of $0.35 from $0.33.
-- It is also raising its full year 1998 estimate to a profit of $0.38 from $0.32.
-- EVEREN analyst Todd Hinrichs said the loss for fiscal 1996 reflects regulatory and operational issues at the company's Golden Cross gold and silver mine in New Zealand.
-- However, the company has overcome several of these problems and the mine is expected to continue to operate at least until the end of 1997, he added.
-- Hinrichs also said he is hopeful Coeur d'Alene will receive certain permits in early 1997 to bring its Kensington operation in Alaska into production.
-- Coeur d'Alene shares were off 5/8 at 13-7/8.
